_comment: Antigravity platform adapter + swarm harness MCP scope for Starlight Intelligence System. Native support for multi-agent subagent swarms via Antigravity primitives (define_subagent, invoke_subagent, Agent Manager). Canonical starlight-substrate always loaded. Swarm children are read-heavy + progress emitters; conductor carries scoped write surfaces. Built on SIP — see footer.
_loaded_when: Complex multi-perspective work (4-10 complexity), parallel agent orchestration, browser-heavy tasks, async long-running flows, when Antigravity YOLO or Agent Manager is the velocity lever. Full Hive (13-96) for cross-IS or vertical-wide intents.
_write_policy: Swarm children: read + progress artifacts only. Conductor / prime / sentinel: scoped writes to intel/ outputs, vault entries under memory/vaults/, and agent-manager artifacts. Substrate-tier writes still require /starlight-board pre-pass and ultimately route through Claude Code primary harness unless explicitly scoped.

starlight-substrate._role: canonical — always loaded for swarm context, memory, attestation, IS namespace
starlight-substrate._purpose: Vault reads (strategic/technical/creative/operational), agent registry discovery, skill activation lookup, attestation generation for every swarm artifact, memory graph queries for historical patterns across the agent registry

arcanea-mcp._role: canon-read for Arcanea-touched swarms — READ + creative write under guardian rules
arcanea-mcp._purpose: Arcanea canon (Guardians, Vel'Tara, Passport, realm vocabulary) when swarm includes music-is / arcanea vertical agents or luminor-board work
arcanea-mcp._status: scaffold — wire when Arcanea MCP server lands; Phase 1 dependency

_task_scoped_mcps._comment: Declared per-swarm via Antigravity session config or parent orchestrator /ao. Swarm children get read-only subsets by default. Conductor may activate write verbs under pre-approved scope.

github_read_write_scoped._purpose: multi-repo coordination for swarm members working across FrankX / Arcanea / SIS / vertical forks
github_read_write_scoped._pattern: gh repo view, pr list/diff/view, release list; gh pr create/comment only under conductor + board scope
github_read_write_scoped._load_when: cross-repo swarm (e.g. porting a pattern from SIS to a vertical)

vercel_scoped._purpose: deploy status + preview for creator / site vertical swarms
vercel_scoped._pattern: list projects, list deployments, deploy under explicit /ao scope only
vercel_scoped._load_when: site/ or gencreator vertical work in swarm

linear._purpose: alliance / cycle tracking when swarm crosses team boundaries
linear._pattern: list_*, get_* for children; save_* only for conductor under scope

notion._purpose: Ops Hub + daily brief surfaces for operational swarm members
notion._pattern: fetch, search for all; create/update only for conductor + ops vertical

browser_mirror._purpose: Antigravity native browser already provides; MCP Google/Drive/Figma mirrors for vault parity + design context
browser_mirror._load_when: web verticals, sync licensing, live testing, design sync

_secrets_policy._comment: Antigravity swarms never default to secrets. Conductor may receive env-var refs (${VERCEL_TOKEN}) under explicit user or /ao unlock for that swarm only. Leaf agents never see secrets. Any secret need surfaces to Claude Code primary.

_swarm_specific.define_subagent_mcp: Subagent definitions may carry their own lightweight MCP stubs for domain tools (e.g. music-suno, sound-catalog) — registered at define time, cleaned on swarm close.
_swarm_specific.progress_artifact_mcp: Antigravity progress artifacts (todo, report, trace) are emitted directly; optional MCP bridge for persisting them to memory/vaults/ under attestation.
_swarm_specific.agent_manager_hooks: on_subagent_start, on_progress, on_complete, on_error — wire to memory/_audit/swarm/ and ops logs for full traceability.
